Message.Name: Symbol Status
Message.Description: Symbol Status messages contain information regarding equity, debenture, or trading Instruments for the current trading day for the Alpha market. One message is disseminated for each valid symbol at the beginning of each trading day.

Message.Name: Order Book
Message.Description: An Order Book message provides public information for all open non-terms orders in the market at the start of day. One message is disseminated for each valid non-terms order at the beginning of each trading day

Message.Name: Order Book Terms
Message.Description: An Order Book – Terms Message provides public information for all open terms orders in the market at the start of day. One message is disseminated for each valid non-terms order at the beginning of each trading day. Feed clients can use the Order Book – Terms message to initialize their order book for the current trading day.

Message.Name: Assign COP – Orders
Message.Description: An Assign COP – Orders message specifies the calculated opening price (COP) for a security and the participating orders that are priced at the COP. Each Assign COP – Orders message can contain up to 15 orders priced at COP, and the orders are positional. All the orders reported on a single Assign COP – Orders message always belong to the same market side.

Message.Name: Assign COP – No Orders
Message.Description: An Assign COP – Orders message specifies the calculated opening price (COP) for a security and the participating orders that are priced at the COP

Message.Name: Assign Limit
Message.Description: An Assign Limit message is disseminated when former better-priced-limit orders are reset to their true limits.

Message.Name: Market State Update
Message.Description: A Market State Update message is disseminated each time a notice of a market state change or a trading session change is sent from the Trading Engine

Message.Name: MOC Imbalance
Message.Description: The MOC Imbalance message is disseminated for MOC eligible symbols every 10 seconds starting from the beginning of the MOC Imbalance trading session

Field.Name: Paired Volume
Field.Description: This field will not be applicable for closing delayed stocks at 4:00p.m.

Field.Name: Market Order Imbalance Volume
Field.Description: This field will not be applicable for closing delayed stocks at 4:00p.m.

Field.Name: Market Order Imbalance Side
Field.Description: This field will not be applicable for closing delayed stocks at 4:00p.m.

Field.Name: Near Indicative Closing Price
Field.Description: This field will not be applicable for closing delayed stocks at 4:00p.m.

Field.Name: Far Indicative Closing Price
Field.Description: This field will not be applicable for closing delayed stocks at 4:00p.m.

Message.Name: Order Booked
Message.Description: An Order Booked message is disseminated in response to a new non-terms order being entered into the trading system

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: A value of price=0 or 999998 (on the sell or buy side respectively) in the Intraday Order Booked message indicates an Oddlot Market-priced order entered during the Pre-Open market state, or while a stock is halted.

Message.Name: Order Booked Terms
Message.Description: An Order Booked - Terms message is disseminated in response to a new terms order being entered into the trading system

Message.Name: Order Cancelled
Message.Description: An Order Cancelled message is disseminated if a non-terms order is cancelled

Message.Name: Order Cancelled Terms
Message.Description: An Order Cancelled – Terms message is disseminated if a terms order is cancelled

Message.Name: Order Price Time Assigned
Message.Description: An Order Price-Time Assigned message is disseminated when a new Price or Time is assigned to a non-terms order

Message.Name: Order Price Time Assigned Terms
Message.Description: An Order Price-Time Assigned – Terms message is disseminated if a new Price or Time is assigned to a terms order

Message.Name: Stock Status
Message.Description: A Stock Status notification is disseminated in response to a change in stock status from the Trading Engine

Message.Name: Trade Report
Message.Description: A Trade Report is produced when a trade occurs that has no settlement terms

Message.Name: Trade Report Terms
Message.Description: A Trade Report – Terms is produced when a trade occurs that and has settlement terms and has Non-Resident participation with or without settlement terms

Message.Name: Trade Cancelled
Message.Description: A Trade Cancelled message is produced when a trade with no settlement terms is cancelled.

Message.Name: Trade Cancelled – Terms
Message.Description: A Trade Cancelled – Terms message is produced when a trade with settlement terms is cancelled.

Message.Name: Trade Correction
Message.Description: A Trade Correction message is produced when a trade with no settlement terms is corrected

Message.Name: Trade Correction – Terms
Message.Description: A Trade Correction – Terms message is produced when a trade with settlement terms is corrected

Type.Name: Board Lot
Type.Description: Contains the board lot size

Type.Name: Broker Number
Type.Description: An Exchange-assigned public number uniquely identifying a Partici-pating Organization.

Type.Name: Buy Broker Number
Type.Description: An Exchange-assigned public number uniquely identifying a Partici-pating Organization associated with a buy order

Type.Name: Buy Maximum Quantity
Type.Description: The maximum quantity of a mutual fund allowed to purchase.

Type.Name: Buy Minimum Quantity
Type.Description: The minimum quantity of a mutual fund required to purchase.

Type.Name: Buy Display Volume
Type.Description: Public remaining display volume for the buy order

Type.Name: Buy Order ID
Type.Description: Public numeric identifier assigned to the buy order by the trading system

Type.Name: Bypass
Type.Description: An indicator for bypass crosses, which can be printed outside of the Protected NBBO and are not subject to cross interference.

Value.Name: The order is not a Bypass

Type.Name: Calculated Opening Price
Type.Description: The price at which orders will trade at the open

Type.Name: Comment
Type.Description: A text field corresponding to a reason code entered when a stock is halted; or, the initiator of a delayed opening on a stock, or when there is a change to the Oddlot trader on a stock.

Type.Name: Cross Type
Type.Description: Type of crosses originating from a Participating Organization between managed accounts that have the same manager

Value.Name: Default, trade was not a cross.

Type.Name: Currency
Type.Description: The currency associated with a reported price

Type.Name: Cusip
Type.Description: Clearing and settlement registration number

Type.Name: Face Value
Type.Description: The face value of a debenture

Type.Name: Far Indicative Closing Price
Type.Description: The calculated closing price that will maximize the number of shares matched based on closing interest only (MOC, LOC). This calculation excludes continuous market orders.

Type.Name: Imbalance Reference Price
Type.Description: The price that determines if a given limit-priced Market on Close (LOC) order can contribute to the MOC Imbalance. All LOC orders that are priced equal to or more aggressively than this price will contribute to the MOC Imbalance.

Type.Name: Imbalance Side
Type.Description: Marker to indicate which side has an imbalance volume for Market on Close

Type.Name: Imbalance Volume
Type.Description: Identifies the volume of shares of the imbalance side for Market on Close

Type.Name: Initiated By
Type.Description: Indicates which side began the Trade Correction

Type.Name: Is Dark
Type.Description: Indicates at least one side of the trade is dark.

Type.Name: Is Mid Only
Type.Description: Indicates a dark Contra Midpoint Only Plus to Contra Midpoint Only Plus execution

Type.Name: Is Conditional
Type.Description: Indicates a firm-up conditional to firm-up conditional execution

Type.Name: Last Sale
Type.Description: Last sale price of a stock

Type.Name: Listing Market
Type.Description: The market on which a security is listed.

Type.Name: Market Order Imbalance Volume
Type.Description: Indicates the share Imbalance when considering MOC orders only. Note this will not change from Freeze period as MOC orders are not allowed after this time.

Type.Name: Market Order Imbalance Side
Type.Description: Side (buy or sell) of the Market Order Imbalance Volume.

Type.Name: Market State
Type.Description: Indicates the current market state
Type.Format: For regular stock groups, valid values are:

Type.Name: MOC Eligible
Type.Description: Identifies whether the stock is eligible to trade in the Market on Close session each trading day.

Type.Name: Near Indicative Closing Price
Type.Description: The calculated closing price that will maximize the number of shares matched based on on-close orders (MOC, LOC) and visible continuous market orders. Effectively, this is the price at which the closing print would occur at the time of publication.

Type.Name: Non-Resident
Type.Description: A terms marker indicating that trade participant is not a Canadian resident

Value.Name: Yes
Value.Description: Participant is not a Canadian resident

Type.Name: Order Id
Type.Description: Public numeric identifier assigned to an order by the trading system.

Type.Name: Order Side
Type.Description: Market side of an order
Type.Format: Indicates if an order is a buy order or a sell order

Type.Name: Orig Trade Number
Type.Description: Used with trade corrections to reference previously reported executions

Type.Name: Paired Volume
Type.Description: The number of MOC and LOC shares that are able be matched at the Reference Price.

Type.Name: Price
Type.Description: The price in a valid currency

Type.Name: Price Variation
Type.Description: This field indicates the absolute value of the percentage of deviation of the Near Indicative Closing Price from the Reference Price.

Type.Name: Priority Time Stamp
Type.Description: Time stamp assigned by the Trading Engine to specify time priority of an order. Orders are sequenced in the order book based on symbol, price, and priority time stamp.
Type.Format: Microseconds since the Epoch (00:00:00 UTC, January 1, 1970)

Type.Name: Product Type
Type.Description: The product type for a symbol

Type.Name: Sell Broker Number
Type.Description: An Exchange-assigned number uniquely identifying a Partici-pating Organization associated with a sell order

Type.Name: Sell Display Volume
Type.Description: Public remaining volume for the sell order

Type.Name: Sell Maximum Quantity
Type.Description: The maximum quantity of a mutual fund allowed to sell.

Type.Name: Sell Minimum Quantity
Type.Description: The minimum quantity of a mutual fund required to sell.

Type.Name: Sell Order ID
Type.Description: Public numeric identifier assigned to a sell order by the trading system.

Type.Name: Settlement Date
Type.Description: Settlement date associated with the order

Type.Name: Settlement Terms
Type.Description: Settlement terms associated with the order

Type.Name: Stock Group
Type.Description: An identifier of the stock group

Type.Name: Stock State
Type.Description: The state of the stock

Type.Name: Symbol
Type.Description: A unique alphanumeric identifier for a security

Type.Name: Test Symbol
Type.Description: Indicates the symbol is a test symbol

Type.Name: Trade Date
Type.Description: Effective date of the trade. Will only be filled when the effective date is different from the current date.
Type.Format: Feed clients can obtain the Trade Date by converting the binary to decimal. The Trade Date format is YYYYMMDD.

Type.Name: Trade Number
Type.Description: A unique identifier per stock assigned to each trade

Type.Name: Trade Time Stamp
Type.Description: The time at which the trade occurred, manually set when a trade is added
Type.Format: Feed clients can obtain the Trade Time Stamp by converting the binary to decimal. The Trade Time Stamp is of the format HHMMSS

Type.Name: Trading System Time Stamp
Type.Description: The time at which the event being reported occurred in the Trading Engine
Type.Format: Microseconds since the Epoch (00:00:00 UTC, January 1, 1970)

Type.Name: Volume
Type.Description: The quantity of shares for an order or trade
